{{Quote|The Empire's weapons research division manages numerous top-secret projects that have resulted in astounding new warships, armaments, and battle stations.|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]], ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''|<ref name="Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>}}
The '''Imperial Department of Military Research''' ('''IDMR''') was a government military research agency within the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] responsible for the research and development of military technology such as equipment, small arms, facility components, and armed starships for the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]]. [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Rebus (Galactic Empire)|Rebus]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Rom Mohc]], [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]], and [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]] all had strong ties to the department.

Its major [[Starship/Legends|starship]] production included the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first]], [[Death Star II/Legends|second]] and [[Death Star III|third]] [[Death Star/Legends|Death Stars]], as well as the [[Death Star prototype|prototype]], the ''[[Eye of Palpatine]]'', the [[Galaxy Gun]], the [[HVs-2 hypervelocity gun]] that was designed and produced in cooperation with [[Taim & Bak/Legends|Taim & Bak]], the [[orbital nightcloak]], the [[Sun Crusher]], the [[World Devastator]]s, and the [[Worldcraft]].

Major [[Droid/Legends|droid]] products included [[HMOR homing droid]]s, [[Human replica droid]]s, [[Mark IV sentry droid/Legends|Mark IV sentry droids]], [[IT-O interrogation droid/Legends|IT-O Interrogator]] droids, [[Shadow Droid]]s, and the [[Phase I Dark Trooper|Phase I]], [[Phase II Dark Trooper/Legends|Phase II]] and [[Phase III Dark Trooper|Phase III]] [[Dark Trooper/Legends|dark trooper]] lines.

Major weaponry designs included the [[Composite Beam Superlaser]] technology that they then developed into the [[Concave Dish Composite Beam Superlaser]], the [[Interplanetary Ion Cannon]], and the [[Resonance projector]].

[[General/Legends|General]] [[Arhul Kurumenga]] of the Imperial Department of Military Research, alongside [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Conan Antonio Motti/Legends|Conan Antonio Motti]] and [[Doctor/Legends|Dr.]] [[Bevel Lemelisk]], were to have had a briefing regarding Dr. [[Insmot Bowen]] of the [[Obroan Institute for Archaeology]]'s theory about the various mysterious aspects of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], including a [[Western barrier|barrier]] to the west of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]], being the result of [[Celestial/Legends|Celestial]] technology dating back to the [[Rakatan revolt]].<ref name="The Celestials">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-the-celestials|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut &mdash; The Celestials|int=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut}}</ref>
